components.name: Tab Button (resting)
components.description: Source tab at rest in the desktop tab bar.
components.css: .ds-tab { background: #141414; color: #888; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-tab:hover { background: #1a1a1a; color: #f0f0f0; } .ds-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4500; outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tab-close { font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.4; line-height: 1; } .ds-tab:hover .ds-tab-close { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Tab Button (active)
components.css: .ds-tab-active { background: #1a1a1a; color: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; cursor: pointer; white-space: nowrap; display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 8px; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.85rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-tab-close { font-size: 1rem; opacity: 0.4; line-height: 1; } .ds-tab-active:hover .ds-tab-close { opacity: 1; }

components.name: Gallery Toggle (4chan)
components.description: Button in the Reddit gallery to switch to 4chan.
components.css: .ds-toggle-4chan { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #0f9d58; color: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.85; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-4chan:hover { opacity: 1; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-toggle-4chan:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Gallery Toggle (Reddit)
components.description: Button in the 4chan gallery to switch to Reddit.
components.css: .ds-toggle-reddit { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; background: #ff4500; color: #f0f0f0; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); padding: 8px 16px; border-radius: 8px; text-decoration: none; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 600; text-transform: uppercase; font-size: 0.75rem; letter-spacing: 0.08em; opacity: 0.85; transition: all 150ms ease-out; } .ds-toggle-reddit:hover { opacity: 1; border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.15); } .ds-toggle-reddit:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #ff4500; outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Board Dot (resting)
components.description: Inactive board indicator in the mobile bottom bar.
components.css: .ds-board-dot { width: 8px; height: 8px; border-radius: 50%; background: rgba(255,255,255,0.2); border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 250ms ease-out; position: relative; } .ds-board-dot::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -18px; left: -18px; right: -18px; bottom: -18px; } .ds-board-dot:active { transform: scale(0.85); }

components.name: Board Dot (active)
components.css: .ds-board-dot-active { width: 20px; height: 8px; border-radius: 4px; background: #ff4500; border: none; padding: 0; cursor: pointer; transition: all 250ms ease-out; box-shadow: 0 0 8px rgba(255,69,0,0.4); position: relative; } .ds-board-dot-active::before { content: ''; position: absolute; top: -18px; left: -18px; right: -18px; bottom: -18px; }

components.name: Progress Counter
components.description: Current position indicator in the gallery.
components.css: .ds-progress { position: fixed; top: 56px; right: 14px; background: rgba(10,10,10,0.75); backdrop-filter: blur(10px); -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(10px); color: #888; font-family: 'Inter', -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, system-ui, sans-serif; font-size: 0.72rem; font-weight: 600; padding: 4px 10px; border-radius: 20px; border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.06); z-index: 500; pointer-events: none; letter-spacing: 0.04em; }

narrative.overview:
Faptopia's gallery is not a UI — it's a private room. The walls are black, the lights are off, and the only thing illuminated is the content. The interface disappears into the dark; what remains is a scroll of videos with the barest navigation to move through them. Nothing glow, nothing shiny, nothing announces itself.

This system explicitly rejects: streaming-platform gloss (gradient overlays, floating play buttons, hero banners), dashboard sterility (data tables, sidebar nav, stat counters), and tube-site density (thumbnails grids, trending badges, engagement loops). It is a single-purpose tool: open one file, watch content, close the file. No onboarding, no splash, no performance.
keyCharacteristics: Pure black background as the default state of the room.
Tonal layering, not shadows: elevation through background lightness.
Platform identity via two accent colors, rest of interface is pure grayscale.
Every pixel of chrome justified by function.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: No box-shadow is defined anywhere in the system. A surface's z-position is determined solely by its lightness against the room.

rules.name: The Two-Accent Rule
rules.body: Reddit orange and 4chan green are the only saturated colors. They signal platform context, not interactivity.

rules.name: The No-Display Rule
rules.body: There is no display typography. No hero heading, no headline, no title — the content is the display.

dos: Use the three-step gray ramp (black → #0a0a0a → #141414) for all elevation.
Reserve saturated color exclusively for platform context.
Use prefers-reduced-motion: reduce to strip all transitions.
Test every breakpoint for correct viewport fill.
Use backdrop-filter(blur) as an ambient effect on overlays, not as a primary distinguisher.
Use safe-area-inset-aware positioning on notched phones.
donts: Don't use box-shadow anywhere — depth is tonal, not shadowed.
Don't introduce a third accent color.
Don't use glassmorphism as a decorative style.
Don't over-chrome. No icons, no search, no filters.
Don't animate with bounce, elastic, or spring easing.
Don't use gradient text, gradient borders, or gradient backgrounds.
Don't add splash screens, onboarding, or introductory elements.
